subject: Re: Basalt status: repro green, novel-category gap
body:
Team,

Decisions for the Basalt LRB demo next week:

1. We demo r50x4, per Umar's latency numbers. r50x16 is the accuracy-ceiling slide, not the live demo.
2. The demo storyline is arbitrary category lists at inference time — Katya, prepare to take three audience-suggested category sets live, with the novel-category caveat stated up front.
3. Farah confirmed the Shipyard endpoint is provisioned; freeze the demo checkpoint by Jun 13.

If LRB signs off, Basalt goes to a limited internal API in July. Q3 OKR draft language is with me.

Lucia
